Role of Prescription Opioids in the Treatment of Pain
Prescription Opioid Abuse in the United States
paragraphs: Our mission is to build a leading, diversified biopharmaceutical company committed to improving the lives of people living with serious medical conditions. We have developed, licensed, and acquired a portfolio of meaningfully differentiated products for use in the treatment of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder ("ADHD") and moderate to severe pain. We commercialize our products, consisting of Jornay PM, Belbuca, Xtampza ER, Nucynta ER and Nucynta IR (collectively the "Nucynta Products"), and Symproic, in the United States.
On September 3, 2024, we acquired Ironshore, which had developed and obtained commercial approval to market Jornay PM in the United States.

Jornay PM is a central nervous system ("CNS") stimulant prescription medicine that contains methylphenidate HCl, a Schedule II methylphenidate, which was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration ("FDA") in August 2018 for the treatment of ADHD in people six years of age and older and currently the only FDA-approved stimulant medication that is dosed in the evening.
The acquisition of Ironshore expands our business beyond pain management and establishes a commercial presence in neuropsychiatry via the ADHD market.

Belbuca is a buccal film that contains buprenorphine, a Schedule III opioid, and was approved by the FDA in October 2015 for severe and persistent pain that requires an extended treatment period with a daily opioid analgesic and for which alternative options are inadequate.

Xtampza ER is an abuse-deterrent, extended-release, oral formulation of oxycodone, a Schedule II opioid. Xtampza ER is formulated using our novel abuse-deterrent technology platform, DETERx, which provides extended-release delivery, which is designed to deter abuse and misuse (e.g., crushing, chewing, heating, and injecting). This technology combines an active opioid ingredient with a fatty acid and waxes to form microspheres that are filled into a capsule. These wax-based microspheres are designed to resist particle size reduction and dose dumping when subjected to physical and chemical manipulation.

We are committed to ongoing monitoring and public dissemination of our real-world abuse and diversion data, regardless of the results. The two main sources of real-world abuse, misuse, and diversion data are RADARS® and Inflexxion, an IBH Company. The Researched Abuse, Diversion and Addiction-Related Surveillance (RADARS) System collects product-and geographically-specific data on abuse, misuse, and diversion of prescription drugs through its multiple data sources. Abuse, misuse, and diversion of Xtampza ER has remained low compared to commonly abused Schedule II opioid analgesics since its introduction into the U.S. market. Methods to defeat the tamper resistant properties of Xtampza ER have been reported. However, there is no indication of widespread or expanding abuse or misuse in the data streams evaluated. Potential limitations are based upon the fact that the Poison Center and Treatment Center Program cases involve self-reporting which may lead to: (i) differential misidentification among drug groups which may affect observed differences, and (ii) case counts of drug groups comprised primarily of branded products (other abuse-deterrent formulations of ER opioids) may be overestimated when based on self-reporting and drug groups comprised primarily of generic products (non-abuse-deterrent formulations of ER opioids and IR oxycodone) may be underestimated. The RADARS data represents a single snapshot in time and is subject to change. Therefore, we plan to continue monitoring real world data characterizing the rate of abuse, misuse, and diversion of Xtampza ER.

The Nucynta Products are extended-release ("ER") and immediate-release ("IR") oral formulations of tapentadol, a Schedule II opioid. In November 2008, the FDA approved Nucynta ER and Nucynta IR. Nucynta ER is indicated for the management of severe and persistent pain that requires an extended treatment period with a daily opioid analgesic, including neuropathic pain associated with diabetic peripheral neuropathy in adults, and for which alternate treatment options are inadequate. Nucynta IR is indicated for the management of acute pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatments are inadequate in adults and pediatric patients aged 6 years and older with a body weight of at least 40 kg. In August 2023, the FDA granted New Patient Population exclusivity for Nucynta IR in pediatric patients. This grant extended the period of U.S. exclusivity for Nucynta IR from June 27, 2025 to July 3, 2026. In June 2024, the FDA granted pediatric exclusivity to the Nucynta Products for an additional six months, to January 3, 2027 for Nucynta IR and December 27, 2025 for Nucynta ER.

We have entered into an authorized generic agreement with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. ("Hikma"), pursuant to which we granted Hikma rights relating to an authorized generic version of the Nucynta Products in the United States. In January 2026, a generic equivalent of Nucynta IR 50mg, 75mg and 100mg tablets was approved under an abbreviated New Drug Application ("ANDA") filed by a third party with the FDA, which carves out pediatric use from its label. As a result of the anticipated launch of the third-party generic equivalent of Nucynta IR, Hikma launched a generic version of Nucynta IR on February 25, 2026. Hikma is expected to launch a generic version of Nucynta ER in the first quarter of 2026.

Symproic, an oral formulation of naldemedine, was approved by the FDA in March 2017 for the treatment of opioid-induced constipation ("OIC") in adult patients with chronic non-cancer pain, including patients with chronic pain related to prior cancer or its treatment who do not require frequent (e.g., weekly) opioid dosage escalation.

ADHD is a CNS disorder characterized by developmentally inappropriate levels of inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity. Diagnosis of ADHD requires a comprehensive clinical evaluation based on identifying patients who exhibit the core symptoms of inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity.
In 2022–2023, approximately 11.4% of children or 7.1 million aged 3–17 and 6% of adults or 15.5 million had a current diagnosis of ADHD in the United States.

ADHD often begins in childhood and can persist into adulthood. The prevalence of children ever diagnosed increases by age. Over 90% of individuals with childhood ADHD will continue to struggle with residual, fluctuating symptoms and impairments through young adulthood.

ADHD symptoms may present as predominantly inattentive, predominantly hyperactive/impulsive, or combined inattentive/hyperactive/impulsive. ADHD may contribute to low self-esteem, troubled relationships, and difficulty at school or work.

headings: Risks Related to Our Financial Position and Capital Needs
Our ability to use our net operating loss carryforwards and certain other tax attributes may be limited.
We have substantial outstanding indebtedness, which may adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
Our opioid products are subject to mandatory REMS programs, which could increase the cost, burden and liability associated with the commercialization of these products.
Unfavorable outcomes in intellectual property litigation could be costly and potentially limit our ability to commercialize our products.

If we are unable to obtain or maintain intellectual property rights for our technologies, products or any products we may acquire, we may lose valuable assets or be unable to compete effectively in our market.

We have been, and may continue to be, forced to litigate to enforce or defend our intellectual property, which could be expensive, time consuming and unsuccessful, and result in the loss of valuable assets.
If we are unable to protect the confidentiality of our trade secrets, our business and competitive position would be harmed.
Risks Related to the Commercialization of Our Products
If the medical community, patients, and healthcare payors do not accept and use our products, we will not achieve sufficient product revenues and our business will suffer.

Current and future legislation and regulatory changes may increase the difficulty and cost for us to continue to commercialize our products and may reduce the prices we are able to obtain for our products.
The Affordable Care Act and any changes in healthcare law may increase the difficulty and cost for us to continue to commercialize our products and affect the prices we may obtain.
If the FDA or other applicable regulatory authorities approve generic products with claims that compete with our products, our sales could decline.
paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. Investors should carefully consider the risks described below, as well as all other information included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our financial statements, the notes thereto and the section entitled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations." If any of the following risks actually occurs, our business, financial condition, operating results, prospects and ability to accomplish our strategic objectives could be materially harmed. As a result, the trading price of our common stock could decline and investors could lose all or part of their investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also impair our business operations and the market price of our common stock.

Our business is subject to a number of risks and uncertainties, including those risks discussed at length below. These risks include, among others, the following principal risk factors that make an investment in our company speculative or risky. You are encouraged to carefully review our full discussion of the material risk factors relevant to an investment in our business, which follows the brief bulleted list of our principal risk factors set forth below:
•Our ability to maintain profitability is dependent upon our ability to continue successfully commercializing our products and any products we may acquire in the future;
•We have substantial outstanding indebtedness, which may adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations;
•Adverse developments affecting the financial services industry could adversely affect our business, financial condition, or results of operations;

•If we cannot continue successfully commercializing our products and any products that we may acquire in the future, our business, financial condition and results of operations may be materially adversely affected and the price of our common stock may decline;

Our mission is to build a leading, diversified biopharmaceutical company committed to improving the lives of people living with serious medical conditions. We have developed, licensed, and acquired a portfolio of meaningfully differentiated products for use in the treatment of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder ("ADHD") and moderate to severe pain. We commercialize our products, consisting of Jornay PM, Belbuca, Xtampza ER, Nucynta ER and Nucynta IR (collectively the "Nucynta Products"), and Symproic, in the United States.

Jornay PM is a central nervous system ("CNS") stimulant prescription medicine that contains methylphenidate HCl, a Schedule II methylphenidate, which was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration ("FDA") in August 2018 for the treatment of ADHD in people six years of age and older and currently the only FDA-approved stimulant medication that is dosed in the evening. We began recognizing product revenue related to Jornay PM in September 2024 following our acquisition of Ironshore Therapeutics Inc. ("Ironshore") (the "Ironshore Acquisition").

Belbuca is a buccal film that contains buprenorphine, a Schedule III opioid, and was approved by the FDA in October 2015 for severe and persistent pain that requires an extended treatment period with a daily opioid analgesic and for which alternative options are inadequate. We began shipping and recognizing product revenue related to Belbuca in March 2022 following our acquisition of BioDelivery Sciences International, Inc. ("BDSI").

Xtampza ER, an abuse-deterrent, extended-release, oral formulation of oxycodone, is a Schedule II opioid and was approved by the FDA in April 2016 for the management of severe and persistent pain that requires an extended treatment period with a daily opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatment options are inadequate. We commercially launched Xtampza ER in June 2016.

The Nucynta Products are extended-release ("ER") and immediate-release ("IR") oral formulations of tapentadol, a Schedule II opioid. In November 2008, the FDA approved Nucynta ER and Nucynta IR. Nucynta ER is indicated for the management of severe and persistent pain that requires an extended treatment period with a daily opioid analgesic, including neuropathic pain associated with diabetic peripheral neuropathy in adults, and for which alternate treatment options are inadequate. Nucynta IR is indicated for the management of acute pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatments are inadequate in adults and pediatric patients aged 6 years and older with a body weight of at least 40 kg. We began shipping and recognizing product revenue on the Nucynta Products in January 2018 and began marketing the Nucynta Products in February 2018. In August 2023, the FDA granted New Patient Population exclusivity for Nucynta IR in pediatric patients. This grant extended the period of U.S. exclusivity for Nucynta IR from June 27, 2025 to July 3, 2026. In June 2024, the FDA granted pediatric exclusivity to the Nucynta Products for an additional six months, to January 3, 2027 for Nucynta IR and December 27, 2025 for Nucynta ER.

We have entered into an authorized generic agreement with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. ("Hikma"), pursuant to which we granted Hikma rights relating to an authorized generic version of the Nucynta Products in the United States. In January 2026, a generic equivalent of Nucynta IR 50mg, 75mg and 100mg tablets was approved under an abbreviated New Drug Application ("ANDA") filed by a third party with the FDA, which carves out pediatric use from its label. As a result of the anticipated launch of the third-party generic equivalent of Nucynta IR, Hikma launched a generic version of Nucynta IR on February 25, 2026. Hikma is expected to launch a generic version of Nucynta ER in the first quarter of 2026.

Symproic, an oral formulation of naldemedine, was approved by the FDA in March 2017 for the treatment of opioid-induced constipation ("OIC") in adult patients with chronic non-cancer pain, including patients with chronic pain related to prior cancer or its treatment who do not require frequent (e.g., weekly) opioid dosage escalation. We began shipping and recognizing product revenue related to Symproic in March 2022 following our acquisition of BDSI.

Product revenues through the year ended December 31, 2025 were generated from sales of Jornay PM, Belbuca, Xtampza ER, the Nucynta Products, and Symproic. In accordance with Accounting Standards Codification Topic 606, Revenue from Contracts with Customers, ("ASC 606") product sales are recorded upon delivery of products to customers (upon the transfer of control of the product to the customer), net of a provision for estimated chargebacks, rebates, sales incentives and allowances, distribution service fees, and returns.

Cost of product revenues include amortization and impairment expense for the intangible assets acquired in connection with business combinations and asset acquisitions, royalty expenses, the cost of active pharmaceutical ingredient, the cost of producing finished goods that correspond with revenue for the reporting period, as well as certain period costs related to freight, packaging, stability and quality testing. Refer to Note 5, License Agreements, and Note 11, Goodwill and Intangible Assets, for further detail around the intangible assets acquired from the Ironshore Acquisition, the BDSI Acquisition, the Nucynta Intangible Asset, and royalty expenses.

Research and development expenses have historically consisted of product development expenses incurred in identifying, developing, and testing product candidates including stock-based compensation; costs associated with conducting our clinical and non-clinical activities, including clinical and non-clinical trials that we conduct for post-marketing requirements; and costs for laboratory supplies, depreciation of lab equipment, and other expenses including allocated expenses for rent and maintenance of facilities. These costs have historically been expensed as incurred.

As of April 1, 2022, we focused entirely on commercial products rather than research and development and redirected resources from research and development activities. As such, there were no expenses incurred in research and development after the three months ended March 31, 2022.

Selling, general and administrative expenses consist primarily of salaries and employee-related costs, including stock-based compensation and travel expenses for our employees. Other selling, general and administrative expenses include expenses related to commercial activities, such as sales, marketing, and market access, facility-related costs, professional fees for directors, accounting and legal services, and expenses associated with obtaining and maintaining patents. As we continue to invest in the commercialization of our products, we expect our selling, general and administrative expenses to continue to be substantial for the foreseeable future.

paragraphs: 本公司之使命為建立一家領導性、多元化之生技製藥公司，致力於改善患有嚴重醫療狀況之民眾之生活。本公司已開發、取得授權及購入一組具備顯著差異性之產品，用於治療注意力不足過動症（"ADHD"）及中度至重度疼痛。本公司商業化其產品，包括 Jornay PM、Belbuca、Xtampza ER、Nucynta ER 及 Nucynta IR（合稱 "Nucynta Products"），以及 Symproic，於美國市場。
於 2024 年 9 月 3 日，本公司取得 Ironshore，其已開發並取得商業許可，於美國市場銷售 Jornay PM。
Jornay PM 是一種作用於中樞神經系統（"CNS"）之處方藥物，含有 methylphenidate HCl，為 Schedule II 之 methylphenidate，於 2018 年 8 月經美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）核准，用於治療六歲以上之 ADHD 患者，目前為唯一經 FDA 核准之刺激劑藥物，於晚上服用。
取得 Ironshore 使本公司業務拓展至疼痛管理之外，並在 ADHD 市場建立商業存在。
Belbuca 是一種口腔薄膜，含有 buprenorphine，為 Schedule III 之阿片類藥物，於 2015 年 10 月經 FDA 核准，用於治療需長期使用每日阿片類止痛藥之嚴重且持續性疼痛，且其他治療選擇不充分之情形。
Xtampza ER 是一種防濫用、延效、口服之 oxycodone，為 Schedule II 之阿片類藥物。Xtampza ER 使用本公司創新之防濫用技術平台 DETERx 製造，提供延效釋放，設計用以防止濫用與濫用（例如：壓碎、咀嚼、加熱與注射）。此技術將主動阿片類成分與脂肪酸及蠟結合，形成微球體，填入膠囊中。這些蠟基微球體設計用以抵抗物理與化學操作時之粒子大小減少與劑量過量釋放。

本公司致力於持續監測並公開散佈本公司實際濫用與轉售資料，不論結果如何。實際濫用、濫用與轉售資料之主要來源為 RADARS® 及 Inflexxion，為 IBH 公司。研究濫用、轉售與成癮監測系統（RADARS）透過其多種資料來源，收集藥物濫用、濫用與轉售之產品及地理特定資料。自 Xtampza ER 預售至美國市場以來，其濫用、濫用與轉售情形較常見濫用之 Schedule II 阿片類止痛藥為低。已報導方法用以破解 Xtampza ER 之防篡改特性。然而，在評估之資料流中，尚無顯示廣泛或擴張之濫用或濫用之跡象。潛在限制基於毒物中心與治療中心計畫之案例涉及自報，可能導致：(i) 藥物羣組間之差異性誤認，可能影響觀察到之差異，以及 (ii) 藥物羣組主要由品牌產品組成（其他延效阿片類藥物之防濫用配方）之案例數可能因自報而被高估，而主要由一般產品組成（非防濫用延效阿片類藥物及 IR oxycodone）之藥物羣組可能因自報而被低估。RADARS 資料代表某一時點之快照，可能隨時間而改變。因此，本公司計畫持續監測實際資料，以說明 Xtampza ER 之濫用、濫用與轉售率。

Nucynta Products 為延效（"ER"）及立即釋放（"IR"）口服之 tapentadol，為 Schedule II 之阿片類藥物。於 2008 年 11 月，FDA 核准 Nucynta ER 及 Nucynta IR。Nucynta ER 用於治療需長期使用每日阿片類止痛藥之嚴重且持續性疼痛，包括糖尿病末梢神經病變成人之神經病變疼痛，且其他治療選擇不充分之情形。Nucynta IR 用於治療嚴重足以需要阿片類止痛藥之急性疼痛，且其他治療選擇不充分之成人及年齡 6 歲以上、體重至少 40 公斤之兒童患者。於 2023 年 8 月，FDA 授予 Nucynta IR 在兒童患者之新患者羣體獨佔權。此獨佔權將 Nucynta IR 之美國獨佔期從 2025 年 6 月 27 日延長至 2026 年 7 月 3 日。於 2024 年 6 月，FDA 授予 Nucynta Products 兒童獨佔權，延長六個月，至 2027 年 1 月 3 日為 Nucynta IR，至 2025 年 12 月 27 日為 Nucynta ER。

本公司已與 Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. ("Hikma") 簽訂授權通用藥品協議，根據該協議，本公司授權 Hikma 有關美國 Nucynta 產品之授權通用藥品權利。2026 年 1 月，第三方向美國食品藥物管理局 (FDA) 提交簡化新藥申請 ("ANDA")，獲准上市與 Nucynta IR 50mg、75mg 與 100mg 片劑相同之通用藥品，其標籤排除兒童使用。由於預期第三方通用藥品 Nucynta IR 即將上市，Hikma 於 2026 年 2 月 25 日推出 Nucynta IR 通用藥品。Hikma 預期於 2026 年第一季推出 Nucynta ER 通用藥品。
Symproic 為口服型 naldemedine 製劑，於 2017 年 3 月獲美國食品藥物管理局 (FDA) 批准，用於治療成人慢性非癌症疼痛患者之阿片類藥物誘發便祕 ("OIC")，包括因過去癌症或其治療而產生慢性疼痛且不需頻繁 (例如每週) 增加阿片類藥物劑量之患者。
ADHD 為一種大腦神經系統 (CNS) 難題，特徵為發展階段不適當的注意力不集中、過動與衝動。ADHD 的診斷需經綜合臨牀評估，以識別符合注意力不集中、過動與衝動核心症狀之患者。
2022–2023 年，美國約 11.4% 的兒童或 7.1 百萬歲 3–17 歲，以及 6% 的成人或 15.5 百萬人被診斷為 ADHD。
ADHD 通常在兒童時期開始，可能持續至成年。診斷過的兒童比例隨年齡增加而上升。超過 90% 的兒童 ADHD 患者在年輕成人階段仍會面臨殘餘、波動的症狀與功能障礙。
ADHD 症狀可能表現為以注意力不集中為主、以過動/衝動為主，或混合型注意力不集中/過動/衝動。ADHD 可能導致自尊心低落、人際關係問題，以及學校或工作中困難。

paragraphs: 你應閱讀下列對我們財務狀況與營運成果之分析，並與本表單 10-K 中其他處所出現之合併財務報表及相關附註一併參考。下列討論包含風險、不確定性與假設之預測性陳述。我們實際之結果與某些事件之時程可能與這些預測性陳述所預期者有重大差異，原因在於許多因素。我們討論我們認為可能導致或促成這些差異之因素，如下文及本表單 10-K 其他處所所述，包括那些於「預測性陳述」及「風險因素」部分所述，並經時而時因地補充之風險。
我們對 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務狀況與 2024 年 12 月 31 日財務狀況之比較分析，如下所述。如欲瞭解 2024 年 12 月 31 日財務狀況與 2023 年 12 月 31 日財務狀況之比較，請參閱我們 2024 年 12 月 31 日財務年度之年度報告表單 10-K 中第二部分，項目 7，「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析」。
我們的使命是建立一家領導性、多元化之生技製藥公司，致力於改善患有嚴重醫療狀況之民眾之生活。我們已開發、授權及取得一組具備顯著差異之產品，用於治療注意力不足過動症（"ADHD"）與中度至嚴重疼痛。我們在美國商業化我們之產品，包括 Jornay PM、Belbuca、Xtampza ER、Nucynta ER 和 Nucynta IR（合稱為 "Nucynta 產品"），以及 Symproic。

Jornay PM 是一種中央神經系統（"CNS"）刺激劑處方藥物，含有 methylphenidate HCl，為 Schedule II 之 methylphenidate，於 2018 年 8 月獲美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）核准，用於治療年滿六歲之 ADHD 患者，目前為唯一經 FDA 核准之刺激劑藥物，於晚上給藥。我們於 2024 年 9 月開始認列與 Jornay PM 相關之產品收入，此為我們取得 Ironshore Therapeutics Inc.（"Ironshore"）（"Ironshore 收購"）後之結果。

Belbuca 是一種頰部薄膜，含有 buprenorphine，為 Schedule III 之阿片類藥物，於 2015 年 10 月獲 FDA 核准，用於治療需長期使用每日阿片類止痛藥之嚴重且持續性疼痛，且替代治療選擇不足之情況。我們於 2022 年 3 月開始發貨並認列與 Belbuca 相關之產品收入，此為我們取得 BioDelivery Sciences International, Inc.（"BDSI"）後之結果。
Xtampza ER 是一種具濫用阻卻特性、延效型口服 oxycodone，為 Schedule II 之阿片類藥物，於 2016 年 4 月獲 FDA 核准，用於治療需長期使用每日阿片類止痛藥之嚴重且持續性疼痛，且替代治療選擇不足之情況。我們於 2016 年 6 月正式上市 Xtampza ER。

Nucynta 產品為延效型（"ER"）與即效型（"IR"）口服 tapentadol，為 Schedule II 之阿片類藥物。2008 年 11 月，FDA 核准 Nucynta ER 與 Nucynta IR。Nucynta ER 用於治療需長期使用每日阿片類止痛藥之嚴重且持續性疼痛，包括成人之糖尿病末梢神經病變相關神經痛，且替代治療選擇不足之情況。Nucynta IR 用於治療成人及年滿六歲、體重至少 40 公斤之兒童之嚴重疼痛，足以需要阿片類止痛藥，且替代治療選擇不足之情況。我們於 2018 年 1 月開始發貨並認列 Nucynta 產品之產品收入，並於 2018 年 2 月開始行銷 Nucynta 產品。2023 年 8 月，FDA 授予 Nucynta IR 在兒童患者之新患者羣體獨佔權，此獨佔權將 Nucynta IR 在美國之獨佔期從 2025 年 6 月 27 日延長至 2026 年 7 月 3 日。2024 年 6 月，FDA 授予 Nucynta 產品在兒童患者之獨佔權，再延長六個月，Nucynta IR 獨佔期至 2027 年 1 月 3 日，Nucynta ER 獨佔期至 2025 年 12 月 27 日。

我們與 Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc.（"Hikma"）簽訂授權通用藥品協議，根據此協議，我們授予 Hikma 在美國關於 Nucynta 產品之授權通用藥品權利。2026 年 1 月，第三方向 FDA 提交簡化新藥申請（"ANDA"），核准 Nucynta IR 50mg、75mg 與 100mg 片劑之通用藥品，其標籤排除兒童使用。由於預期第三方通用藥品 Nucynta IR 之上市，Hikma 於 2026 年 2 月 25 日上市 Nucynta IR 之通用藥品。Hikma 預期於 2026 年第一季上市 Nucynta ER 之通用藥品。
Symproic，一種口服形式的納爾德米尼，於2017年3月獲美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准，用於治療成人慢性非癌症疼痛患者的阿片類藥物誘發便祕（"OIC"），包括因過去癌症或其治療而產生慢性疼痛且不需頻繁（例如每週）增加阿片類藥物劑量的患者。我們於2022年3月開始發貨並確認與Symproic相關的產品收入，此後我們收購了BDSI。
截至2025年12月31日的會計年度，產品收入來自Jornay PM、Belbuca、Xtampza ER、Nucynta產品及Symproic的銷售。根據會計準則編碼主題606，與客戶的合約收入（"ASC 606"），產品銷售於產品交付給客戶時（即產品控制權轉移給客戶時）確認，扣除預估的退貨、回扣、銷售激勵及折扣、分銷服務費用及退貨的預估費用。
產品收入的成本包括因企業合併及資產收購所取得的無形資產的攤銷及減損費用、版稅費用、活性藥物成分的成本、與報告期間收入相對應的成品製造成本，以及與運輸、包裝、穩定性及品質測試相關的某些期間成本。有關從Ironshore收購、BDSI收購、Nucynta無形資產及版稅費用所取得的無形資產的更多細節，請參閱附註5，授權協議，及附註11，商譽及無形資產。
研究與開發費用歷來主要包括識別、開發及測試產品候選藥物所產生的產品開發費用，包括股票激勵薪酬；進行臨牀及非臨牀活動的相關費用，包括為符合上市後要求而進行的臨牀及非臨牀試驗；以及實驗室用品費用、實驗室設備折舊費用及其他費用，包括分配的租金及設施維護費用。這些費用歷來均於發生時計入費用。
自2022年4月1日起，我們專注於商業產品而非研究與開發，並將資源從研究與開發活動轉移。因此，在2022年3月31日結止的三個月期間後，不再產生研究與開發費用。
銷售、一般及行政費用主要為員工薪資及相關費用，包括股票激勵薪酬及員工差旅費用。其他銷售、一般及行政費用包括與商業活動相關的費用，例如銷售、市場推廣及市場准入、設施相關費用、董事專業費用、會計及法律服務費用，以及取得及維護專利相關的費用。隨著我們持續投資於產品的商業化，我們預期銷售、一般及行政費用在可預見的未來仍將保持高水準。

headings: 與我們財務狀況及資金需求相關的風險
本公司運用淨營業虧損結轉及某些其他稅務屬性之能力可能受到限制。
本公司負有大量未償還債務，可能不利於本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果。
與我們產品相關的風險
本公司阿片類製品需遵守強制性風險管理計畫（REMS），此可能增加這些產品商業化之成本、負擔及責任。
與智慧財產權相關的風險
智慧財產權訴訟結果不利於本公司，可能導致高昂成本，並可能限制本公司商業化產品之能力。
若本公司無法取得或維持對我們技術、產品或任何可能取得之產品之智慧財產權，本公司可能喪失重要資產或無法有效競爭於市場。
本公司已曾且可能繼續被迫進行訴訟以執行或防禦本公司之智慧財產權，此過程可能耗費大量金錢與時間，且未必成功，並可能導致本公司喪失重要資產。
若本公司無法保護本公司商業機密之保密性，將對本公司業務與競爭地位造成損害。
與產品商業化相關之風險
若醫療界、患者及醫療給付者不接受並使用本公司產品，本公司將無法取得足夠之產品收入，並導致本公司業務受損。
現行及未來之立法與監管變動可能增加本公司持續商業化產品之困難與成本，並可能降低本公司所能取得之產品價格。
《平價醫療法案》（Affordable Care Act）及任何醫療法規之變動可能增加本公司持續商業化產品之困難與成本，並影響本公司所能取得之產品價格。
若美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）或其他適用之監管機關核准具有與本公司產品競爭之聲請之仿製藥品，本公司之銷售額可能下降。
paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股涉及高度風險。投資人應謹慎考量下列所描述的風險，以及本年度報告表10-K所包含的所有其他資訊，包括財務報表、財務報表附註及「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」部分。若任何下列風險實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果、前景及達成戰略目標的能力造成重大損害。因此，本公司普通股的交易價格可能下跌，投資人可能喪失全部或部分投資。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未為本公司所知或本公司認為不重要，也可能影響本公司業務運作及普通股的市場價格。
本公司業務面臨許多風險與不確定性，包括下列在下文中詳細討論的風險。這些風險包括，但不限於下列主要風險因素，使投資本公司成為一種投機性或高風險的投資。您被鼓勵仔細審閱本公司對與投資本公司業務相關的重要風險因素的完整討論，該討論位於下列主要風險因素簡要清單之後：
•本公司維持獲利能力取決於本公司持續成功商業化產品及未來可能取得的產品的能力；
•本公司負有大量未償債務，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運結果產生不利影響；
•影響金融服務業的不利發展可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運結果產生不利影響；
•若本公司無法持續成功商業化產品及未來可能取得的產品，本公司業務、財務狀況及營運結果可能受到重大不利影響，並導致本公司普通股的價格下跌；
